prompt: Some people think the news has no connection to people’s lives, so then it is a waste of time to read the news in the newspaper and watch television news programs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
These days, news are updated every minute through televisions, mobile phones, or traditional newspapers and magazines. Some people choose to read them all to catch up with every event happening around the globe, while others choose to ignore them, considering it a waste of time. I agree that there are many irrelevant news these days; however, I still think that everyone should spend time keeping track of the world’s developments.

First of all, I believe most news nowadays is written about unnecessary topics and clickbait headlines, which are created to aim for grabbing readers’ attention. This kind of article is probably a waste of time, it tends to focus on Hollywood celebrities’ lives, showbiz scandals, and personal dramas all over the world. Spending time on these articles is such a needless activity, because it does not develop an individual’s perception of the surrounding world.

On the other hand, there is news that is relevant to our everyday life. For instance, reading articles about discussions on newly established policies and news on academic fields like education, politics, national economy are topics that can deeply contribute to our quality of life. Moreover, having a wide perspective on society’s flow can help people make informed decisions, rather than being ignorant and making blind choices, which can strongly affect their lives. A popular example of this phenomenon is back in 2020, when COVID-19 disease started to spread all over the world; news were updated frequently, and it helped people to prepare groceries during the pandemic.

To conclude, although there is news that are not worth the time to read, I do believe that there are still crucial articles that we should notice to be informed about the world’s trends.
